content: Tammwayas sivines beiweiys Yeisuw

Iyakousis anilivan tasiyas, Yeisuw mo idibakes navamul, ilana, “Adok kukwakinsa akweiy yam mo Kaltuwon Sigeilin; teitan mo bisilkodeig, Gimgilitoun yey. Gamag mwasanin mo biyousigs bikatimateigs waklos.”
Misiya̱mun towen tasiyas tanuwgwes lun situwa̱vek sisiyas tammwayas katuyouns ineis tanuwgwes lun sitovek avakaein wanven, mtowen yagan Kayapas.
Sivines kid biyousis Yeisuw bikatimates; illivans silma̱nin.
Ilansa, “Kadiloka tasinaps beibwein; ama̱wan bitayousis. Awoum bitayousis sagal waseg; peinan gamag singay babaw; adok mwasanin bikayuses, igaw mo bikawpwanaws.”
Na̱tan vin iptum Yeisuw kunun
Yeisuw nises Betaniy, Saymon wanbunatum, mtowen toulepel.
Na̱tan vin inek Yeisuw, nabotol bwanabwein wanaman, tagon nises, tage maysan singay avakaein. Yeisuw igaw ikamkwam, isap mana̱wen, tagon towen iligubok kunun Yeisuw.
Navamul ikines, ikavikuns, ilansa, “Bo iyamkwen tagon bwanabwein. Kadiloka biyamiyis, maysan avakaein bikow, money towen bivgen tasiyas tasimavs wasigeis.”

Yeisuw gog bo itilikwen asilivan, ikatimop, ilana, “Awoum kulivans, ivag geg anmwasin. Inawotet bwanabwein waseg yey. Tut babaw tasiyas tasimavs simiyas nukusesus; yey gog kweitan, igaw mo balisaweimiy. Bo iptum woug silma̱nin anatut bidibwanigs. Mounid adibakeimiy, ampalawen ven watinow igaw bikawes liva̱neig, o liva̱nen-vak mana̱wen vin bikawes binawes, gamag babaw biliganes, mo bininuways inawotet towen.”
Yudas itam kid bisilkod Yeisuw

Yeisuw navamul sinawatan teiy, teitan gog yagan Yudas Iskaliyot inekes tasiyas tanuwgwes lun situwa̱vek, ilana, “Kweivin maysan bukusekeigs mo bakamtel Yeisuw avanuy misikey-yay, mo bukuyousis?” Isenas money silib sinawatoun, mo itam.
Wankuyeim Yudas inineiv amata-ked bwein waseg mo bisilkod Yeisuw.
Kaltuwon Sigeilin
Yam towen isilamaws anawik bikatunags silma̱nin Kaltuwon Sigeilin. Navamul Yeisuw inekes, ilansa, “Avanuy bakakatineg sagal towen va̱gan bukukwam?” Wik towen nag beikams bled son yist; bwaboum.
Iw to Yeisuw, ilana, “Kunekes mtowen nises waven, kudibakes, kulansa, ‘Matovek ilivan, ilana: Tutag bo alivet, wambunatum baka̱kam Kaltuwon Sigeilin, sigwey gunavamul.’”
Tasiyas iliganes, ikanawes aygan, inounas, ineis, ikatinages sagal towen.
Kwayav mo isinis siney navamul tasiyas sinawatan teiy, beikams.
Igaw ikamkwams, ilivan, “Mounid adibakeimiy, teitan nises wasigeis yakamiy, igaw mo bisilkodeig.”
Singay igeg ninous, katanok katanok mo idibakes, ilansa, “Tamwey, kal bisilkodeim? Yey? o nag? kavel?”
Ikatimop, ilana, “Mtowen soug kakokew kan wakabmavin, igaw mo bisilkodeig.

“Gimgilitoun yey ba̱noy ban makadewen ked nilivnakes Bukitab waseg, tage taw towen tasilkodeig singay kalbaleb bilivet. Magat inan nag bikop taw towen bo bwein, tage bo ikop, mo singaya kalbaleb bilivet.”
Tasilkodein Yeisuw yagan Yudas mo ikatigan, ilana, “Guntovek yak, mtowen kavel? Yey?” Iw to Yeisuw, ilana, “Ma̱wan.”
Datoveks inakamkwam
Igaw ikamkwams, Yeisuw ikow bled, anilivan bwanabwein isek, mo ivgen, isekes inavamul wasigeis, ilana, “Kaeimiy towen woug, kukwams.”

Ikous, mo ikow kwa̱vig, ikalin nuwan Yowbad waseg, ikiv, isekes, ilana, “Tababaws yakamiy kumoums towen buya̱vig silma̱nin kaleiwag kweivaw; buya̱vig iwta̱wout biwid kid amisinap kalbaleb, simiyas gamag babaw.
“Adibakeimiy, nag vayuwein ba̱moum gleip sipinen ee... anatut kweivaw sipinen mo bitamoums Tamag wanakabkaleiwag.”
Asiwous ikanweles ikous, mo isaps ineis koy towen bigulen oliv nises.
Yeisuw ilivnek Pita bikayan
Ineis koy towen, Yeisuw idibakes, ilana, “Boug towen bukupiyaveigs amibabaw-wan yakamiy, liva̱nen nises Bukitab waseg, mamagina:

content.text: ‘Ba̱weiy tamtakavatein mansiyas sip, mo bikatigayes alen.’

content: “Igaw ba̱kit vayuwein mo bamug ban Galiliy waseg; yakamiy wankuyeim, mo kuwekeigs Galiliy waseg.”
Iw to Pita, ilana, “Magat babaw bipiyaveims, yey gog nag bapiyaveim.”
Yeisuw ilivan, “Adibakeim yak, boug towen waseg bukwaya̱neig sivatoun, mo beigel kolkolek.”
Iw to Pita, ilana, “Kukin bikatimateims, soug yak bikatimateids aditeiy. Nag bakaya̱neim, nag.” Inavamul babaw asilivan bo ma̱wan.
Getsemaniy waseg initoug
Siney navamul mo ineis ven yagan Getsemaniy, idibakes, ilana, “Kusinis towen. Yey ban palatan anitoug Yowbad waseg.”
Mo idawes tasiyas Pita siney Sebediy nitun asteiy, mo ivag asteivas, ineis isiwas; mo igeg nanon, won imouvit seikwan.
Idibakes, “Woug moumouvit ma̱wana dakul, kakita bakanig adok. Bweina kusesus towen kula̱lals, kulabeigs nitoug waseg.”
Inoun, nag in kadiveiyov, imasis kantukov, initoug, ilana, “Tamag, magat bukutam bo bapiyev kwa̱vig towen, singay yayan; tage ama̱wan ya̱koum nanoum, nanoug yey awoum.”

Ikous, iyum inekes asteitoun, bo imasis. Idibek Pita, “Ta-bukula̱lals bukulabeigs tut kadiyakus waseg. Kutoukums, kula̱lals, kunnitougs; mata ge bukusiws abiyokon waseg. Bo iseiw nuwamiy wotet towen, tage tougwey yakamiy.”
Sivyuwein in initoug, ilana, “Tamag, adok nag kadilok bukwayus kwa̱vig towen, bweina ba̱moum. Aveiyag wananoum bo bavag ma̱wan.”
Iyum inekes bo imasis, peinan bo inanup mites.
Sivtounun ilisawes, initoug; anilivan ma̱wana nilivan mo initoug.

Ikous, iyum inekes navamul, idibakes, ilana, “Igaw kuyeiwas, kummasis. Bo deis! Datuts bo ikous. Bo isap tasilkodeig Gimgilitoun yey. Takalbalebs bo nimeis kid biyousigs yey. Kukits tanounas, tasilkodeig bo isap!”
Iyousis Yeisuw
Yeisuw igaw ilivan, isap inavamul teitan yagan Yudas, siney babaw gamag ikokews sipulut seiy, sinew seiy. Tanuwgwes lun situwa̱vek sisiyas tammwayas nikayabes nimeis.
Towen tasilakod bo nidibakes, “Kukin kal bakamuloul soug, towen kuyousis, mtowen Yeisuw.”
Nuwanaw mo inek Yeisuw, ilivan, “Kalin nuwag guntovek yak,” mo imulouls son.
Iw to Yeisuw, ilana, “Gwa, wawun nukum?” Ituts tasiyas, iwekes, iyousis Yeisuw, itawtouns waseg.
Son Yeisuw teitan igut napulut wakaban nises, iweiy natouwat tanuwgwes lun sitovek, ibob teigan.

Iw to Yeisuw, ilana, “Kuyamen mupulut, bein wakaban. Tasiyas gog tawayins gamag pulut waseg, igaw bikanka̱nigs pulut waseg. Adok nag kukwakins gunanitoug waseg Tamag, nuwanaw mo beitam min-liba̱lab bilabeigs, singay babaw tawsans. Nag gog. Kukin nag biyousigs, ta-ma̱wan bikamat liva̱neig Bukitab nilivnek.”

Misiya̱mun towen Yeisuw idibakes asibabaw, ilana, “Yam babaw nases Yowbad wanbunatum akatimlakes gamag, ta-kuyousigs. Nagein gog aveiyag wawun kukokews mipulut, minew, nukumeis kuyousigs mamagina tavveinaw yey? Tage youd towen ikamat peinan tasiyas palopit nilivnakes Bukitab waseg.” Navamul aspwa̱yat ilisawes Yeisuw; mo isawls.
Yeisuw iya̱tal waseg Kayapas
Iyousis Yeisuw ikous, inawes Kayapas wanbunatum; mtowen tanuwgwes lun sitovek avakaein. Inaven waseg nikatuyouns nimeis tammwayas sisiyas takatimlakeins kaleiwag.
Mtowen gog Pita ikikikun wankuyeim ee... isap waven, isin waven siney tamwey towen natouwats, idoki aveiyag binuwakes.
Tasiyas tanuwgwes lun situwa̱vek sisiyas takaleiwags babaw inineivs kalisiy biyaweids ya̱tal waseg va̱gan kid mo bikatimates Yeisuw.

Babaw iyaweids, Yeisuw silma̱nin, tage nag iba̱nes silawun ya̱tal, nag. Wankuyeim asteiy mo imeis, ilansa, “Taw towen ilivan, ‘Kadilokeig bagulek Yowbad nabunatum, yam kweitoun mo bawlulavaw bayakous.’”
Itamanaw tanuwgwes lun sitovek, ikatigan Yeisuw, ilana, “Aveiyag bukwatimop? Aveiyag amsinap towen, tasiyas nillivans?”
Yeisuw gog isesuna ikika̱pay. Iwa̱ge tanuwgwes lun sitovek, ilana, “Tamwamov Yowbad iligen amlivan yak; kadiloka kulivan mounid. Tab ya̱koum Yowbad Natun, Mesay? o nag?”
Yeisuw idibek, ilana, “Ma̱wan amlivan. Vayuwein livan mo badibakeim:

content.text: ‘Igaw bukukineigs Gimgilitoun yey, biseinig Yowbad wanaka̱tay, guntawtoun waseg; mo bukukineigs wa̱lov walba̱lab bawekeimiy.’”

content: Kayapas, kapasal nuwan, iksigeb anakweim, ilana, “Bo kuliganes anilivan towen kalbaleb. Nag ivag sivinads gamag biyateles; babaw ya̱kids nitaliganes anilivan kalbaleb. Ama̱wan bitanuwakes mtowen?”
Mo igusus Yeisuw magin, iwaweiys nimes waseg. Igawa iwaweiys, mwasanin ilansa, “Magat ya̱koum Kelis, bukulivan ma̱wana palopit ya̱koum, kwavteg yagan kal iweim!”
Pita ikayan Yeisuw
Pita igaw nises Kayapas wanven, wamatan nabunatum, tawtelein bunatum na̱tan inek, ilana, “Adok ya̱koum soum Yeisuw mukunoys Galiliy nukumeis, ne?”
Ikayan mtowen, ilana, “Nag. Ta-akakin aveiyag nukulivan.” Babaw gamag ikatiliganes anilivan towen.
Isineikik in wadunan ked waseg, nayuwein vin ikin, idibakes siney, ilana, “Taw towen veiyon gum-Nasalet towen Yeisuw.”
Ikayan vayuwein, ilana, “Nag bakakin gamag towen. Tamad!”
Igaw kakit, tasiyas nitomos wadadan ven iwekes Pita, ilansa, “Adok mounid ya̱koum veiyon gum-Galiliy ya̱koum, ne? Peinan aygam ma̱wana aga-Galiliy.”
Ikavikun Pita, anilivan kalbaleb igegayous, itabudabod, ilana, “Nag; ta-bakakin taw towen. Tamad!” Mo igel kolkolek.
Pita inuway Yeisuw anilivan, “Nuwanaw bukupiyaveig sivatoun, mo beigel kolkolek.” Inuway livan towen, isunap, inoun in tana̱ban, iva̱lam, singay igeg nanon.
